Sandbox_LasciviousScriptsZombieDecay_Ena: Controls the complete world-age-driven zombie decay system.
Sandbox_LasciviousScriptsZombieDecay_Tim: 100 uses the default milestones: 7, 30, 180, 365 and 730 days. 50 is twice as fast; 200 takes twice as long.
Sandbox_LasciviousScriptsZombieDecay_Min: Runner speed reached around the six-month milestone. Default: 50%% of original runner speed.
Sandbox_LasciviousScriptsZombieDecay_Fin: Off: once every runner is gone (day 365) the population stays 100%% Fast Shambler forever. On (default): starting at the day-730 milestone, Fast Shamblers gradually turn into plain Shamblers over another 730 days, reaching 100%% Shamblers by day 1460.
Sandbox_LasciviousScriptsZombieDecay_Deb: Prints phase, percentage and speed calculations to the console. Leave disabled in production.
Sandbox_LasciviousScriptsTimeVote_Enable: Adds unanimous multiplayer voting for 5x/20x/40x. A granted speed is applied once and native/single-player interruption semantics are respected: movement, danger or another reset on any player returns everyone to 1x.
Sandbox_LasciviousScriptsTimeVote_SoloOn: When on, fast-forward is only ever available while exactly one player is online. Time and the vote UI are forced back to 1x and hidden the moment a second player joins, and reappear once it is back down to one.
Sandbox_LasciviousScriptsTimeVote_DebugL: Prints NetTimedAction acceleration details to the console. Leave disabled in production.
